messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened PR to merge 429/timeouts runbook into a single troubleshooting doc. Need owners for: link cleanup, SDK retry snippet, canary sample, and quick test script. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1245 :eyes:

sam: assign me link cleanup + small editorial pass. I'll scan for stale links and update to console URLs.

anika: I can do SDK retry snippet (python + node). Want to prefer unified SDK header example? Suggest example using Retry-After parsing + exponential backoff. Will push snippet.

lee: we should include minimal repro script for synthetic 429s using local dev server. I have a shell snippet. cc @tj for canary test infra.

tj: ok I'll wire the canary test. need the sample load script (curl loop or locust); ping me when snippet lands.

docs-bot: Reminder: doc lint failed on PR — trailing whitespace in docs/troubleshooting.md line 312

maria: Thanks @sam @anika @lee @tj. @sam can you file a follow-up issue for redirecting old anchor names? We get broken refs from earlier releases. @anika pls add both python and js examples under /snippets/retries. I'll address lint and rebase.

sam: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/789 - added checklist

anika: draft pushed for python snippet, using headers: 'x-retry-after' as internal fallback, and 'Retry-After' per spec. node snippet coming in next commit. Leaving inline comments for the SDK team.

lee: pasting shell snippet:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"pump"}' http://localhost:8080/generate || break; sleep 0.2; done
```
It simulates burst + should hit 429 if rate limits set low.

tj: I'll add to canary as job `docs-429-smoke` and set to run 6x/day. Needs nat table for egress; will coordinate with eng-infra.

maria: :thumbsup: attaching short checklist
- owner labels
- snippets added
- lint green
- link redirects issue
- canary job created
- doc review sign-off

sam: :eyes: will review once lint fixed. I'm good to merge link changes after we ensure redirects ticket lands in the queue.

anika: Node snippet pushed. Also added inline comment showing how to parse `Retry-After` in seconds and fallback to exponential backoff.

maria: ok merging in 30m unless objections. cc @eng-sre for any infra blockers.

lee: @eng-sre can we temporarily lower rate limit on dev stack for the canary tests?

eng-sre: We can lower per-team dev rate by 10x for a 24h window; please schedule and give start time.

tj: Scheduling 06:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll post the run link here.

maria: Merged. Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: @sam open PR to add redirect meta. @tj add canary job. I'll monitor analytics for any regressions.
